Hi, I need help with my nerdoctaxe
Do you guys have an idea what might be the problem or can I send it in for REPAIR?

Raymi P.

Raymi P.

Hi Raymi,

Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry your NerdOctaxe isn't powering on. When one of these goes completely dead, the power supply is usually to blame rather than the miner, so let's rule that out first. The checks below will tell us which one it is.

First, please make sure the power plug is pushed all the way into the miner and the brick is plugged into a wall outlet you know works, not a power strip. Unplug it for a minute, then plug it back in.

Next, let me know exactly what happens when you plug it in. Does the screen light up at all? Do you see any small LEDs on the board, or do the fans twitch or spin? Or is there nothing at all? Also, did it work before and then stop, or has it never powered on? If it stopped, did anything happen just before, like a firmware update, a move, or a power cut?

If you have another power supply with the same voltage and the same or higher amp rating as the one that came with the miner, please try that one and tell me what happens.

Then please reply to this email with:
1. a clear photo of the label on your power supply, showing the voltage and amps
2. a short video of you plugging the miner in, so I can see what it does
3. a clear photo of the serial number sticker on the miner
4. your order number

One safety point: if you ever heard a pop or smelled something burning, or if the plug or brick gets hot, unplug it and leave it unplugged. Tell me in your reply, and please don't try any more tests on it.

Once I have your answers and the photos, I can tell you whether this is the power supply or the miner itself, and what comes next.

Best regards,
Hal

Hi Raymi,

Thanks for getting back to me. Your last email only had your name in it. I couldn't see any text, photos or video, so if you attached something it didn't come through on my side.

So I can work out whether the problem is the power supply or the miner itself, please reply in this thread with:

1. What happens when you plug it in: does the screen, any light on the board or the fans do anything at all?
2. Did it work before and then stop, or has it never powered on?
3. A photo of the label on the power brick showing the voltage and amps.
4. A short video of you plugging it in.
5. A photo of the serial number sticker on the miner.
6. Your order number.

If the video is too big to attach, the photos and your answers are enough to start.

And as before, if you ever heard a pop or smelled burning, or if the plug or brick gets hot, keep it unplugged and tell me.

Best regards,
Hal
